name: Interstate Shopping Center
summary: Interstate Shopping Center is a neighborhood retail property on Franklin Turnpike in Ramsey, New Jersey, managed by Welco Realty. The center serves the affluent Bergen County community with convenient access to everyday shopping and services.
demographics: Interstate Shopping Center serves the affluent northern New Jersey communities of Ramsey and surrounding Bergen County areas. The trade area attracts middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes typically exceeding $100,000, drawn from established suburban neighborhoods. Primary shoppers include working professionals aged 35-65 and families seeking convenient access to everyday retail and services. The center benefits from its location along Franklin Turnpike, a major thoroughfare connecting multiple residential communities in one of New Jersey's most prosperous counties.
description: Interstate Shopping Center is a well-established neighborhood retail destination located on Franklin Turnpike in Ramsey, New Jersey, serving the prosperous Bergen County community. Managed by Welco Realty, a respected commercial real estate firm based in New Rochelle, New York, the center has been a reliable shopping option for local residents seeking convenient access to everyday goods and services. The property benefits from its strategic location along a major thoroughfare, providing excellent visibility and accessibility for the surrounding suburban communities. With a solid 4.2-star rating from over 1,600 reviews, Interstate Shopping Center has built a reputation as a dependable neighborhood retail hub. The center operates daily from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM, offering consistent hours that accommodate the busy schedules of working families and professionals in the area.
